description: First real hyperplane_ffn experiment: clone of exp001 (MinimalGPT+RoPE, untied head) with the dense MLP FFN in all 6 blocks replaced by a single-head HyperplaneMultiHeadLUT (hard forward, always-soft backward). LUT machinery mirrors the latest FastMHL recipe (bf16 LUT storage + grad_clip 1.0 + Lion 2e-4/(0.9,0.95)/wd0); the NEW hyperplane weights w and bias b are fp32 + Adam, NO weight decay. Compares against the exp001 anchor 1.20144 val_bpb. NOTE: at tables_per_head=128 the module is ~1.54x the FFN params (10.9M vs 7.08M) -> whole model ~39.6M vs exp001's 35.79M; this is a deliberate capacity choice, not a param match.
